kjv: from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
note: TR adds "and the Lord Jesus Christ" from the other Pauline greetings; absent from B, D, and others.

kjv: we have redemption through his blood
note: TR adds "dia tou haimatos autou" from Eph 1:7; absent from all early Greek manuscripts.
prototokos pases ktiseos is a title of rank and priority (1:16 "for by him all things were created"); "of every creature" can suggest that Christ is himself the first creature, the Arian reading.
